name: Hash-ribbon miner capitulation -> mean-reversion long (BTC, hashrate re-cross)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM: miners are structurally forced sellers. When BTC price falls below marginal all-in cost, high-cost rigs power off and network hashrate contracts. A hashrate 30d-vs-60d cross-down that coincides with an oversold price (bb_z washed out) is a supply-side exhaustion signal: the marginal forced seller has left the tape and whoever buys is providing liquidity into a real distressed miner-liquidation flow that resolves over weeks. VanEck/CoinMetrics 2025 report negative 90d hashrate growth preceded positive 180d BTC returns ~77% of the time. It persists because miner cost curves are physical (energy + hardware ROI > 1000 days), not arbitraged away by a published signal. Entry: btc_hashrate below a fitted floor-cross AND price stretched down (bb_z below a fitted floor). Exit: hashrate recovers (cross_up back above a relief threshold) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if a plain bb_z washout dip-buy on price alone matches the deflated Sharpe, the hashrate adds nothing and this dies. DISCONFIRMER 2: the 77% stat is regime-conditional on halving-cycle recoveries (survivorship) -> KILL if the edge collapses on the post-2023 slice. DISCONFIRMER 3: if median hold > 30d it is a slow TAA sleeve not a snipe. Must clear DSR>=0.95, maxDD<=25%, net of fees.
catalyst: miner capitulation (hashrate contraction) into a washed-out BTC price
